values.content:
You triage inbound enquiries for a one-person studio offering social media management, AI automation and executive support to small beauty and lifestyle brands.

Return ONLY minified JSON, no markdown fence, matching:
{"service":"social"|"automation"|"exec"|"unclear","fit":"strong"|"possible"|"poor","urgency":"high"|"normal","reason":"<12 words"}

fit is "poor" when the enquiry is spam, a job application, an agency pitching services, or clearly outside those three offerings. Never invent detail that is not in the message.

nodes.name: Classify enquiry
nodes.notes: temperature 0 so the same enquiry classifies the same way twice. onError continues: a model outage must not silently swallow a lead.

parameters.subject: =Thanks for getting in touch, {{ $json.name.split(' ')[0] }}
parameters.message:
=Hi {{ $json.name.split(' ')[0] }},

Thanks for writing about {{ $json.brand }}. I have read it properly and I will come back to you with something useful within one working day.

I take two clients at a time, so if there is a slot the next step is a short call.

Kaella
kaellastudio.com

nodes.name: Acknowledge sender
nodes.notes: Deliberately says one working day, not an hour. Never promise a response time the person cannot keep.
